links.outcome: Association of AI frailty index with postoperative outcomes in an external cohort
links.effect: Highest frailty quintile had higher odds of 30-day mortality (OR 4.33, 95% CI 3.91-4.80) and 2.53 times longer hospital stays vs lowest level.
links.quote: The developed preoperative frailty index effectively predicts postoperative outcomes in a large and diverse external cohort.

links.outcome: Predictive performance of general vs service-specific frailty indices
links.effect: General frailty index performed comparably to or slightly better than service-specific indices across surgical specialties.
links.quote: The general frailty index performed comparably to or slightly better than service-specific indices across surgical specialties.

screen.reason: This study performs a large-scale retrospective external validation across a multicenter consortium (OneFlorida+) of an existing EHR-based AI frailty index, testing generalizability across surgical specialties.
